title: NTA CSIR UGC NET June 2026 Result, with Score Card
organization: National Testing Agency / Council of Scientific & Industrial Research
postName: Joint CSIR UGC NET June 2026 Result and Score Card
vacancyDetails: CSIR UGC NET June 2026 result, score card and subject-wise eligibility for JRF and Lectureship / Assistant Professor
qualification: M.Sc. or equivalent degree with 55% marks for General / OBC candidates and 50% marks for SC / ST / PH candidates, subject to the official CSIR UGC NET rules. Integrated courses, B.E. / B.Tech, B.Pharma and MBBS candidates may also be eligible.
ageLimit: For JRF: maximum 30 years. For Lectureship / Assistant Professor: no upper age limit.
applicationFee: General: Rs. 1150; EWS / OBC: Rs. 600; SC / ST / PH: Rs. 325. Payment through debit card, credit card, net banking or UPI.
selectionProcess: Computer-Based Test -> Result / Score Card -> JRF and/or Lectureship / Assistant Professor eligibility
documentsRequired: Application number, password or date of birth, registered details and a valid device for downloading the score card.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official CSIR UGC NET result portal
2. Open the Result / Score Card link
3. Enter the application number and password or date of birth
4. Submit the details and view the score card
5. Download and print the result for future reference
6. Verify subject, marks, qualification status and category details
shortDescription: NTA CSIR UGC NET June 2026 Result and Score Card are available. Candidates can download the score card from the official result login portal.
content:
National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the CSIR UGC NET June 2026 Result and Score Card for the Joint Council of Scientific & Industrial Research UGC National Eligibility Test.

The examination was conducted on 17-18 July 2026. Candidates can download their score card using the official result login link and check marks, subject details and eligibility status for JRF and Lectureship / Assistant Professor.

CSIR UGC NET June 2026 Subjects

  • Chemical Science
  • Earth, Atmospheric, Ocean and Planetary Science
  • Life Science
  • Mathematical Science
  • Physical Science

Important Dates

  • Application began: 27 May 2026
  • Last date to apply: 19 June 2026
  • Exam fee payment last date: 20 June 2026
  • Correction window: 22-23 June 2026
  • Exam date: 17-18 July 2026
  • Answer key: 16 August 2026
  • Final answer key: 29 August 2026
  • Result declared: 29 August 2026
  • Score card available: 11 September 2026

Candidates should download the official score card and keep a copy for admissions, fellowship, eligibility and further academic or recruitment processes. Always verify details through the official NTA / CSIR NET portal.
importantInstructions: Download the score card only from the official result portal and verify the subject, marks and eligibility status before using it for any academic or recruitment purpose.

faqs.question: When was the CSIR UGC NET June 2026 score card released?
faqs.answer: The score card was made available on 11 September 2026.

faqs.question: How can candidates download the score card?
faqs.answer: Use the official result link, enter the application number and password or date of birth, then download and print the score card.

faqs.question: Which subjects are covered in CSIR UGC NET June 2026?
faqs.answer: Chemical Science, Earth Science, Life Science, Mathematical Science and Physical Science.
